title: Failing liquidation
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  In the `setLiquidationManager()` function of the `PositionManager` contract, when the `liquidationManager` address is changed, the new contract is not granted approval on the share tokens for all registered vaults.
